name: Wetlands for Wildlife Grants
summary: Annual grants to restore, enhance and create wetlands and riparian areas in Colorado. Non-profit habitat groups, tribes, local governments and companies can apply; private landowners cannot apply directly.

amount.note: Up to approximately $1.121 million. Funding sources are Great Outdoors Colorado and Colorado waterfowl stamps.

reporting: Quarterly project updates to the CPW Wetlands Program Coordinator until completion, plus a final project report on completion.

status.quote: The next round of grant applications is expected to open in February 2027.

recurring.quote: Colorado Parks and Wildlife annually seeks applications for wetland and riparian restoration, enhancement, and creation projects

deadline.text: Applications due to the Wetlands Program Coordinator
